import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Find rectangular outlines as color bounding boxes with full rectangular perimeter.
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
       c=g[i][j]
       if c==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
       stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); pts=[]
       while stack:
        y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
         q=(y+dy,x+dx)
         if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and g[q[0]][q[1]]==c:
          seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
       ys=[a for a,b in pts]; xs=[b for a,b in pts]; comps.append((c,min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)))
    frames=[]
    for c,y0,y1,x0,x1 in comps:
      if y1-y0<2 or x1-x0<2: continue
      # bounding rectangle outer boundary has color along all sides
      if all(g[y0][x]==c and g[y1][x]==c for x in range(x0,x1+1)) and all(g[y][x0]==c and g[y][x1]==c for y in range(y0,y1+1)):
       frames.append((c,y0,y1,x0,x1))
    # source is frame with most nonzero interior cells
    def interior(f):
      c,y0,y1,x0,x1=f; return (y0+1,y1-1,x0+1,x1-1)
    counts=[]
    for f in frames:
      a,b,c,d=interior(f); color=f[0]
      counts.append(sum(g[y][x]!=0 and g[y][x]!=color for y in range(a,b+1) for x in range(c,d+1)))
    if not frames or max(counts)==0:return g
    s=frames[counts.index(max(counts))]; sy0,sy1,sx0,sx1=interior(s); sh=sy1-sy0+1; sw=sx1-sx0+1
    pattern=[[1 if g[y][x]!=0 else 0 for x in range(sx0,sx1+1)] for y in range(sy0,sy1+1)]
    for f in frames:
      if f==s: continue
      c,y0,y1,x0,x1=f; ay,by,ax,bx=interior(f); th=by-ay+1; tw=bx-ax+1
      for y in range(ay,by+1):
       for x in range(ax,bx+1):
        py=min(sh-1,int((y-ay)*sh/th)); px=min(sw-1,int((x-ax)*sw/tw))
        g[y][x]=c if pattern[py][px] else 0
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
